Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.<br>RabbitMQ business job delivery is asynchronous; ACK/NACK arrows are separate one-way AMQP protocol commands, not new business events.<br>Successful original preparation publishes to R2 whether CDN is disabled, succeeds, or fails. First R2 upload in configured try can also trigger its fallback catch.<br>Workspace cleanup runs in finally for claimed attempt. Progress events are awaited enqueue operations, not awaited consumer completion.<br>Exception operands explicitly terminate later pipeline stages. Retry/failure persistence occurs before the media-to-handler result; retry publication failure reaches NACK(requeue) inside its operand." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=13;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="5792" width="2164" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
RabbitMQ business job delivery is asynchronous; ACK/NACK arrows are separate one-way AMQP protocol commands, not new business events.
Successful original preparation publishes to R2 whether CDN is disabled, succeeds, or fails. First R2 upload in configured try can also trigger its fallback catch.
Workspace cleanup runs in finally for claimed attempt. Progress events are awaited enqueue operations, not awaited consumer completion.
Exception operands explicitly terminate later pipeline stages. Retry/failure persistence occurs before the media-to-handler result; retry publication failure reaches NACK(requeue) inside its operand.
